newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's MEFF equity volume at record high in June.
newsitem.headline: Spain's MEFF equity volume at record high in June.

text.p: The trading volume in equity derivatives on Spain's MEFF futures exchange rose to a record high in June of 814,265 contracts, 95 percent up versus a year ago.
That was also higher than the previous high in May 1997.
In a statement, MEFF said the accumulated figure for the first semester of 1997 was 4.006 million contracts, up 66 percent versus the year-ago period.
Traded Ibex-35 futures contracts reached 550,304 setting also a record high.
